checks.note: Image-rights link labels use per-image licenseLabel rather than a hardcoded Creative Commons label. scopeReview.assessment: Supported historical representation: Nasaw/Catawba, Cherrikies/Cherokee, Chickisa/Chickasaw. Integration preserves actual labels and archive explanations without claiming a known maker or present boundaries.
Packet supports Techkonis-to-Munsee bridge and explicitly broader, overlapping Lenape/Delaware reading links. No unique modern-government succession or precise descent is inferred.
Packet records actual title and scan town/river labels. Integration preserves Kitchin's engraving and mediated Indigenous draught distinction, without assigning one modern Cherokee government.
Packet supports Second Seminole War contextual connection. Integration visibly identifies military perspective and excludes Seminole authorship, homeland-map equivalence, and current jurisdiction.
